title.zh: 绿色峡谷：台达杯绿建改造

summary.zh: 以贯穿既有体量的绿色峡谷组织通风、采光与公共流线，重塑建筑的环境性能和共享界面。
summary.en: A green canyon cuts through the existing mass to organize ventilation, daylight and public circulation while renewing environmental performance.
